name: eegml-portal
description: Members' portal for #EEGManyLabs: a static single-page application with a Firebase backend.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.editor.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eegml/shared && npm run build -w @eegml/functions && npm run build -w @eegml/web
scripts.build:staging: npm run build -w @eegml/shared && npm run build -w @eegml/functions && npm run build:staging -w @eegml/web
scripts.build:production: npm run build -w @eegml/shared && npm run build -w @eegml/functions && npm run build:production -w @eegml/web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --only auth,firestore,storage emulated:without-functions && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --only auth,firestore,functions emulated:functions-shard-1 && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --only auth,firestore,functions emulated:functions-shard-2 && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --web emulated:e2e-shard-1 && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --web emulated:e2e-shard-2 && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --web emulated:e2e-shard-3 && npm run restore:rehearse
scripts.test:functions: npm run build -w @eegml/functions && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --only auth,firestore,functions emulated:functions-shard-1 && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --only auth,firestore,functions emulated:functions-shard-2
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --web emulated:e2e-shard-1 && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --web emulated:e2e-shard-2 && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --web emulated:e2e-shard-3
scripts.seed:demo: node scripts/emulators.mjs run npm run --silent -w @eegml/tools cli -- seed:demo
scripts.seed:lookups: node scripts/emulators.mjs run npm run --silent -w @eegml/tools cli -- seed:lookups
scripts.access:rebuild: node scripts/emulators.mjs run npm run --silent -w @eegml/tools cli -- access:rebuild
scripts.integrity:check: node scripts/emulators.mjs run npm run --silent -w @eegml/tools cli -- integrity:check
scripts.admin:bootstrap: node scripts/emulators.mjs run npm run --silent -w @eegml/tools cli -- admin:bootstrap
scripts.publish:verify: node scripts/emulators.mjs run npm run --silent -w @eegml/tools cli -- publish:verify
scripts.governance:replay: node scripts/emulators.mjs run npm run --silent -w @eegml/tools cli -- governance:replay
scripts.deploy:check:staging: node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --only firestore,storage deploy:check:run -- --environment staging
scripts.deploy:check:production: node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --only firestore,storage deploy:check:run -- --environment production
scripts.functions:package: npm run build -w @eegml/shared && npm run build -w @eegml/functions && node scripts/functions-package.mjs
